title: My Hero Academia Creator Breaks Silence on Shonen Jump Return After 2 Years
content: My Hero Academia creator Kohei Horikoshi has officially made his return to Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine with a brand new story after two years, and the creator has opened up about his comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: Nippon Ichi Software's Gobble Side-Scrolling Game Heads West in 2027
content: NIS America announced on Tuesday that it will release Nippon Ichi Software 's GOBBLE , a new side-scrolling game , in the West in 2027 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Announces TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume Anime for Fall 2026 Streaming
content: The original slice-of-life anime TETSURYO! meet with Tetsudou Musume will stream exclusively on HIDIVE as part of its Fall 2026 simulcast lineup, beginning this October. Ahead of the release, the series will hold its world premiere at Anime NYC on August 21.
author: Anime Corner

title: Gantz Creator Hiroya Oku Plans to Retire After Finishing Kanrekihime Manga
content: "No, this is it. I've made up my mind. To be honest, I just don't have the energy to keep drawing anymore. The desire to create is still there. But coming up with a story, drawing it, and keeping that process going — all of it takes an enormous amount of energy and stamina.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Recasts One of Its Greatest Villains
content: In January earlier this year, the legendary voice actor who brought to life one of Dragon Ball Z’s greatest villains passed away. Kozo Shioya had brought to life Majin Buu for decades, first getting his start in DBZ and then continuing to bring the pink powerhouse to life across video games, movies, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Multi-Mind Mayhem Anime Reveals First Trailer, Key Visual, January 2027 Release Date
content: Multi-Mind Mayhem ( Isekai Tensei Sodoki) anime revealed its first trailer, key visual, along with a January 2027 release date and the main staff. Studio DEEN is handling the animation for the project, which was first announced in March this year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Village in the Shade Game Launches for West on October 27
content: NIS America announced in a trailer on Monday that it will launch Nippon Ichi Software 's Hono Gurashi no Niwa game in the West under the title Village in the Shade on October 27 for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . The company also released a "Sunshine Version" of its trailer.
author: ANN

title: Tsutomu Nihei's Tower Dungeon Manga Tops 1 Million in Circulation Globally
content: The official X/Twitter account for manga creator Tsutomu Nihei 's editors announced on August 6 that Nihei's Tower Dungeon manga has over 1 million copies in circulation worldwide. Nihei launched the manga in Monthly Shonen Sirius in October 2023. Kodansha published the manga's sixth compiled book volume on March 9.
author: ANN
